findings.detail: Saying that “aspect path validation” consumes the emitted membership suggests that returned finding locations are checked against it. In fact, aspect_status checks finding paths only with safe_path and copies membership_paths into status metadata. A schema-valid finding naming module/other passes validation even when that path is outside membership. This wording can mislead maintainers about the validator’s guarantee.
findings.fix: Replace the final sentence with: “Prompts, changes and the gate consume the emitted paths. Aspect validation checks scope consistency and reports membership_paths; finding locations are checked for safe relative syntax, not membership. There is no directory-wide editing allowance.”
findings.title: write-markdown: Factual accuracy, clarify that finding-path validation does not enforce membership.

strengths: The documentation clearly explains why internal submodule edits require comparing child trees.
The snapshot explanation accurately distinguishes index changes from disk-content changes and identifies detection limits.
summary: Reviewed the full specified committed diff and checked comments and documentation against the implementation. One wording clarification is suggested; no Important or Critical documentation defects were found.
